sections.heading: Month-over-month snapshot
sections.text:
October brought {acct.conv.cur} conversions at a cost of {acct.cost.cur}, against {acct.conv.prev} conversions in September. Conversions rose {acct.conv.chg_prev} while cost fell {acct.cost.chg_prev}.

Without Brand, cost per conversion was {nb.cpa.cur}, which is {score.cpa_nb.diff_pct} above the {target.cpa} target. Brand searches convert cheaply by nature, so the whole account's figure of {acct.cpa.cur} looks better than the rest of the account performs.
bullets: Against October last year, conversions rose {acct.conv.chg_ly}.
Spend came in {score.cost.diff_pct} below the spend target of {target.cost}, mostly because Drain Cleaning | Search was paused.

sections.heading: Main drivers
sections.text:
Plumbing | Water Heaters was the biggest mover. Its conversions fell {c2.conv.chg_prev} after its bid strategy moved to Target CPA on {chg2.date}, with the target set at {chg2.n1}. That change is the first lead to check, not proven cause.

Plumbing | Emergency grew. Its conversions rose {c1.conv.chg_prev} after its daily budget rose from {chg1.n1} to {chg1.n2} on {chg1.date}. Google's systems also added {chg3.n1} keywords to it on {chg3.date}.
bullets: Drain Cleaning | Search was paused on {chg4.date} and its last day with cost was {c3.last_cost_day}, so its cost fell by {c3.cost.delta_prev.abs}. It did not decline; it stopped.

sections.heading: Budget shifts
sections.text: Plumbing | Emergency took {c1.cost.share_cur} of October's cost and brought {c1.conv.share_cur} of its conversions. The pause of Drain Cleaning | Search freed budget that was not moved elsewhere.

sections.heading: Recommended next actions
bullets: Review the Target CPA on Plumbing | Water Heaters. It was raised after the month closed, so November will show whether that helps.
Decide with you whether Drain Cleaning | Search comes back on, and on what budget.
Judge cost per conversion without Brand from now on, since Brand hides the gap to target.
